description: Schema for CMPDI benchmark ground truth label files.

entity.description: Tests entity alias resolution. alias_text is looked up in entity_aliases; expected_canonical_name must match the resolved canonical entity.

fact.description: Tests unit normalization. Checks that at least one normalized_fact for entity/metric has the expected normalized_unit.

text_extraction.description: Tests text extraction. expected_text_excerpt is compared to extracted text blocks from the document using character-level match rate.

table_extraction.description: Tests table extraction. Checks that expected_value appears in any cell of any extracted table for the document.

conflict.description: Tests conflict detection. If expected_conflict=true, the system must have flagged a conflict for this entity/metric. Drives precision/recall computation.

citation.description: Tests citation accuracy. Checks that a normalized_fact for entity/metric traces back (via extracted_fact) to the expected document.

is_synthetic_rule: is_synthetic MUST be true for any label set derived from deliberately constructed stress-test documents. synthetic_type must also be set. These results are NEVER aggregated with real document results.
